title: His daughters and grandchildren, none in music
summary: His two daughters, one of whom studied singing, and his seven grandchildren all went into other careers.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: You had mentioned before that -- when Ella Fitzgerald left, you know, the Chick Webb orchestra, they wanted you to take it over and have your daughter --
Well, she was at that time -- she was studying singing, and she was going to sing. Her name is Delores. But she never followed it through. She finally got married and --

-- gave up the whole thing. She -- but for a while she started to be a dancer like her mother, and she gave it up. And my other daughter, she always talks -- talked about singing, but she never sang. No. They never -- neither one of them followed the music business.
Seven times, seven grandchildren, and none of them got into music either. Roddy, he's in Milwaukee.

He's a television announcer in Milwaukee, and he -- he started to playing guitar and stuff. And then Donny, he was going to be a flautist, and he got into something else. They all got into something else.

And, oh, my other granddaughter, she's a policewoman in California, and she was going to -- she started playing flute and clarinet, and she had a beautiful voice, good singer, and she never followed -- she got into police work and -- they're all on their other little things, you know.
